description: Report row terminal statuses + fail-closed export gating + explicit failure journeys (missing_input, citation_failed) aligned to the state model and API surface.

userStories.title: Missing docs yields missing_input with checklist
userStories.description: Missing evidence resolves to missing_input with an actionable missing-doc checklist and strict invariants.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-001 Rows with no supporting evidence resolve to missing_input.
AC-002 missing_input rows have answer exactly Not found in provided documents., zero citations, and notes/provenance contains a missing-doc checklist.
AC-003 pack_02_missing_rea produces missing_input rows with a visible checklist.

userStories.title: Bad evidence yields citation_failed and blocks export
userStories.description: Evidence failures yield citation_failed and exports are blocked by default per API contract.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-004 Deliberate bad citation yields citation_failed.
AC-005 POST /export/csv returns error.code=EXPORT_BLOCKED when any row is citation_failed (default).
AC-006 unsafe_override=true is demo-only: when not enabled return 403 UNAUTHORISED; if enabled, artefact is visibly labeled unsafe and metadata records override.

userStories.title: needs_review -> reviewed is explicit and persisted
userStories.description: Reviewer can mark a needs_review row as reviewed; status invariants hold.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-007 Rows can transition needs_review -> reviewed only via explicit user action.
AC-008 needs_review|reviewed rows have >=1 locked citation.
